Class InputActionTreeGroup

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a sorted collection of InputActionTree objects. Provides methods for updating and retrieving input action trees based on various criteria.

public class InputActionTreeGroup : SortedSet<InputActionTree>, ISet<InputActionTree>, ICollection<InputActionTree>, IReadOnlySet<InputActionTree>, IReadOnlyCollection<InputActionTree>, IEnumerable<InputActionTree>, ICollection, IEnumerable, IDeserializationCallback, ISerializable, ICopyable<InputActionTreeGroup>, IComparable<InputActionTreeGroup>, IEquatable<InputActionTreeGroup>
